operations.description: Get a list of Near Earth Objects within a date range, The max range in one query is 7 days
operations.summary: Find Near Earth Objects by date
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] retrieve near earth object feed [PATH] rest feed [PARAMS] date detailed end start [SCHEMA] earth hash list map near object string

operations.description: Get a list of Near Earth Objects for today
operations.summary: Find Near Earth Objects for today
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] retrieve neo feed today [PATH] rest feed today [PARAMS] detailed [SCHEMA] earth hash list map near object string

operations.description: Retieve a paginated list of Near Earth Objects
operations.summary: Browse the Near Earth Objects service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] browse near earth objects [PATH] rest neo browse [PARAMS] page size [SCHEMA] approach class close container data diameter distance earth estimated miss near object orbit orbital rel velocity

operations.description: Retrieves Near Earth Objects listed in the NASA sentry data set
operations.summary: Retrieve Sentry (Impact Risk ) Near Earth Objects
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] retrieve sentry risk data [PATH] rest neo sentry [PARAMS] active is page size [SCHEMA] data dto impact meta object page paging risk sentry

operations.description: Retrieves Sentry Near Earth Object by ID
operations.summary: Retrieve Sentry (Impact Risk ) Near Earth Objectby ID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] retrieve sentry risk data by id [PATH] rest neo sentry [PARAMS] asteroid id [SCHEMA] impact object risk sentry

operations.description: Retrieve a Near Earth Objects with a given id
operations.summary: Find Near Earth Objects by id
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] retrieve near earth object by id [PATH] rest neo [PARAMS] asteroid id [SCHEMA] approach class close container data diameter distance earth estimated miss near object orbit orbital rel velocity

operations.summary: Get the Near Earth Object data set totals
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] retrieve current neo statistics [PATH] rest stats [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] statistics url
